title: CDU duty / standby (one hall)
note: PRD-SETPOINT-SIM P7. Counts, unit rating and load from DCAI_CALC.snapshot.equipment.

basis.ref: ASHRAE TC9.9 liquid cooling guidelines (CDU N+1); Uptime Tier concurrent maintainability practice

plant: Each CDU holds the TCS supply with its HX control valve (registry dcai.cdu/tcs_supply_c); the hall runs its duty CDUs with one standby.

modes.label: Normal, N+1

entry.event: all duty CDUs proven running, standby available

actions: each duty CDU holds TCS supply at its setpoint
the standby CDU is isolated and ready

exit.event: a duty CDU trips (pump, controls or leak isolation)

modes.label: Duty CDU trip — standby start
actions: isolate the tripped CDU and raise an alarm
open the standby CDU's isolation valves and start its pump
the duty count is restored; each unit stays at its load

exit.event: the standby CDU is proven running and the tripped unit is repaired

modes.notModelled: the seconds between trip and standby proven; the rack TCS rise during it

modes.label: High TCS supply
actions: alarm from the registry band of dcai.cdu/tcs_supply_c
check facility water (HTW) supply and the HX valve position
modes.notModelled: rack throttling and time to the alarm limit
